title: Tensor cancellation across a pushout of ring sheaves
statement: Let $T$ be a topological space and $D,C,A,B$ sheaves of commutative rings on $T$. Suppose $r:D\to C$, $s:D\to A$, $b:C\to B$, $t:A\to B$ form a pushout in sheaves of commutative rings. For every sheaf of $A$-modules $M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], there is a $C$-linear isomorphism $e_M:\operatorname{Res}_b(B\otimes_A M)\simeq C\otimes_D\operatorname{Res}_s M$, where the tensors are sheafified sectionwise tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] and restrictions are [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. For every $A$-linear map $a:M\to N$, $e_N\circ\operatorname{Res}_b(1\otimes a)=(1\otimes\operatorname{Res}_s a)\circ e_M$. On every open $W\subseteq T$ and every $m\in M(W)$, $e_M^{-1}(\theta_r(1\otimes m))=\theta_t(1\otimes m)$, with $\theta$ the corresponding sheafification unit.

proof.text: Construct the reverse comparison for any commuting square. On an open W, extend the D-linear map m ↦ theta_t(1 tensor m) to a C-linear map C(W) tensor over D(W) with Res_s M(W) → Res_b(B tensor over A with M)(W). The square equation proves D-linearity. This map sends c tensor m to theta_t(b(c) tensor m). Restriction compatibility on generators assembles a presheaf morphism; the module sheafification Hom equivalence gives the explicit sheaf morphism f_M.

The sheafification universal property and scalar-extension hom extensionality show maps from a tensor sheaf are determined by theta_r(1 tensor m) on all opens. Naturality of the sheafification unit gives the formula for changeOfRingsHom on these generators. Thus f_M is natural in M. Its unit formula follows from b(1)=1. These steps are completely proved by private Lean helpers.

Apply the fixed-comparison invertibility theorem to f_M and the pushout, obtaining IsIso f_M. Set e_M=(asIso f_M).symm. Postcompose the desired naturality square with f_N, use the already proved naturality of f, and cancel the inverse composites. The inverse unit formula is exactly the proved unit formula for f_M.
